scope: Read-only original tracked-tree, original seals and frozen source/input preservation at this observation window. Not game replay, independent business acceptance, remote readback, Chrome/UI/performance or compatibility validation.

method.originalGit: Actual rtk proxy git cat-file --batch original blobs; every blob SHA1, SHA256, size and direct byte equality checked against disk/readlink and opening authority. HEAD ls-tree actual all path/mode/blob identities checked.
method.regularFiles: Physical ancestor lstat; O_NOFOLLOW|O_NONBLOCK file descriptor; before/fstat/after identity stability; streamed full bytes.
method.links: 19 literal readlink byte strings only, hex+SHA recorded; targets never opened or followed.
method.modeBoundary: Opening baseline records Git modes only. Missing seal file modes were checked against these original Git modes. Current complete POSIX modes are observed; historical complete POSIX permission bits and directory permissions were not recorded in the opening baseline and are not invented.
method.newUntracked: Not mixed into original18116; current new P2 source/tests/evidence are outside the original tree baseline. Frozen151 source map is checked separately.
method.observation: Each file is stable during its actual read; this report is an observation window and does not certify later authorized master-record appends.
